output.brief:
Don't roll back the gateway. The regression comes from the 2 Nov storage compaction tuning change (FC-7710), not gateway 5.8. In 11 cells the change raised compaction threads from 2 to 6. Disk use went from 41% to 97% within 5 minutes, disk read waits rose from 9 to 205 ms, and node-side GET time rose from 61 to 262 ms. Latency jumped in each cell minutes after the push, not when 5.8 arrived. aps-3 skipped the push, has had 5.8 since 01:05, and stayed at about 94 ms. A test rollback of euw-1 to 5.7 changed nothing. Network and traffic growth don't fit the timing. A rollback would also reopen the signature vulnerability.

Next step: revert the tuning in one cell, for example use-1, and watch p99 and backlog. If p99 recovers, extend to the other cells. The backlog is about 11% now and is not projected to reach 15% before 13 Nov, so there is time to do this carefully. Don't pause compaction. Hold off on rate-limiting Orrin until the 10 Nov attribution report shows where the backlog came from. Fleet config pushes should also go on the shared change calendar. Confidence is high.
